data.name: Nirvana Carbon Solutions LLC
data.description: Nirvana Carbon Solutions is an early-stage US company based in New Jersey and founded in 2024. PitchBook describes it as a developer of biochar applications that aim to improve crop yield and soil fertility, funded through carbon credit sales. Its only listed investor is the National Science Foundation, through an accelerator/incubator-stage deal.
